record HttpWire.Chunk done: Bool, next: Int, runs: List(Int), state: Int, remaining: Int, size: Int, line: Int, block: Int, count: Int, name: String, name_length: Int, total: Int, limit: Int
record HttpWire.Head method: String, target: String, path: String, headers: List(Struct(Header)), length: Int, chunked: Bool, expect_continue: Bool, buffered: Int, status: Int, reason: String
record HttpWire.Job origin: String, scheme: String, host: String, port: Int, method: String, head: String, body: String, deadline: Int, reply: Channel(Result(Struct(HttpResponse))), worker: Int, kept: Bool
record HttpWire.Reply head: String, closes: Bool
